title: AT24 Regime AI
description:
AT24 Regime AI puts every closed H1 bar into one of five market states and shows what each state has been followed by on your own chart history.

What it does

- Five states: NOISY, WIDE SWING, STRONG MOVE, COMPRESSED and STEADY TREND. The state comes from fixed constants learned once on historical data. Nothing is learned on your chart and the state of a closed bar never changes later, so it does not repaint.

- Dashboard: the current state, how long it has lasted, how often a state stays on the next bar, and for each state the size of the next 24 hours compared with average, with the number of bars behind it.

- Expected next 24 hour range with an 80 percent band, built from the symbol history and its hour of day pattern. The panel shows how often the band held on the last part of the history. It helps size stops and targets. It does not say which way price will go.

- Weekly structure view: trend up, down or range from confirmed weekly swings, the stage, and a plan with entry, stop and target levels drawn on the chart, with the record of the same rules and the number of cases.

- Colour strip of the states in the indicator window, optional alert on a state change, and buffers for EAs (state, run length, ratio, expected range, band low, band high).

Points to know

- The states describe the size of moves, not direction. It is not a trade instruction and does not promise results.

- Made for H1 charts. Other timeframes show a notice.

- Statistics are measured on your broker data and can differ from other symbols. The number of cases is always shown.

- The dashboard is hidden in the Strategy Tester by default.

- Alerts and push messages are written but not yet tested live.

Inputs

History bars for the statistics, bars read from the chart, plan and risk settings, alerts, colours, panel corner and offsets.

Descriptive history on your broker data. Context tool, not a forecast. Not financial advice. Trading leveraged products is risky.

What was verified: compiles with 0 errors and 0 warnings in the real MetaEditor and runs on a real MT5 chart (see the screenshot) and in the Strategy Tester. The five-state engine matches an independent Python calculation on 5 symbols x 8,000 H1 bars (0 state mismatches) and passed 31 hand-worked unit tests and a no-look-ahead test. The weekly plan uses the same rules as AT24 Position Scanner. Not verified: live-money use, alerts and push messages on a live connected chart, the licence check with a real purchase. MetaTrader 5 only.

It is delivered as a licensed utility Expert Advisor with the indicator built into the file (MetaTrader does not allow licence checks inside indicators): attach it to a chart and the panel appears. It never places orders.

title: AT24 Strategy Fit
description:
AT24 Strategy Fit shows how three plain rules performed in each market state on your own symbol history, so you can see which rule has fitted the state the market is in now.

What it does

- Three plain rules are measured: trend, breakout and reversion. Each is tested on the chart symbol H1 history inside five market states (NOISY, WIDE SWING, STRONG MOVE, COMPRESSED, STEADY TREND).

- For every rule and state the panel shows the average result in units of ATR after the spread, the hit rate, the number of trades and a luck test (random sign flips of the same trades).

- A cell is marked FIT only with at least 30 trades, a positive average and a low luck value. It is marked AVOID with 30 or more trades and a negative average. Fewer than 30 trades gives no claim.

- The panel marks the state now, the class of each rule in this state, and the signal of each rule on the last closed bar.

- Optional protective stop in the measured trades. A stop caps each loss. It does not create an advantage.

- A live arrow and an optional alert appear only when a rule signals in a state where its own record is FIT. Buffers for EAs (signals, classes).

Points to know

- It measures the past. A FIT cell can be luck: with many cells some look good by chance. The number of trades and the luck test are there for that reason.

- A symbol with a strong drift can make one side look good because of the drift.

- The spread used is the current spread, swap is not included.

- Made for H1 charts. The dashboard is hidden in the Strategy Tester by default. It places no trades.

- Alerts and push messages are written but not yet tested live.

Inputs

History bars, bars read from the chart, protective stop, alerts, colours, panel corner and offsets.

Descriptive history on your broker data. Context tool, not a forecast. Not financial advice. Trading leveraged products is risky.

What was verified: compiles with 0 errors and 0 warnings in the real MetaEditor and runs on a real MT5 chart (see the screenshot) and in the Strategy Tester. The signals, trades, statistics and luck test match an independent Python calculation on 5 symbols x 20,000 H1 bars (9,387 trades identical) and passed 26 hand-worked unit tests and a no-look-ahead test. Not verified: live-money use, alerts and push messages on a live connected chart, the licence check with a real purchase. MetaTrader 5 only.

title: AT24 Position Scanner
description:
AT24 Position Scanner is one table for many symbols that shows where each one stands in a weekly structure plan, using closed bars only.

What it does

- Reads weekly and H4 history for a list of symbols (up to 24, set by you, with an optional broker suffix) and shows one row per symbol.

- Each row: the weekly trend (up, down or range), what the rules are waiting for (pullback depth, an H4 turn, or a running plan), entry, stop and target levels, the risk in weekly ATR, and the record of the same rules on that symbol with the number of cases. Under 30 cases no claim is shown.

- Symbols that have just triggered sort first.

- Optional alert on a new trigger and on an H4 turn, with an optional push message.

- Swings are used only after they are confirmed and every bar is closed, so rows do not repaint.

Points to know

- It is a planning table, not a trade instruction. A plan can fail and past results do not predict future results.

- Symbol names must exist at your broker. Add a suffix if your broker uses one. Missing symbols are skipped.

- The first load reads a lot of history and can take a short time.

- The table is hidden in the Strategy Tester by default.

- Alerts, swap in the record and lot values are not yet tested live.

Inputs

Symbol list, suffix, swing and pullback settings, stop buffer, history bars, alerts, panel corner and offsets.

Descriptive history on your broker data. Planning tool, not a forecast. Not financial advice. Trading leveraged products is risky.

What was verified: compiles with 0 errors and 0 warnings in the real MetaEditor and runs on a real MT5 chart (see the screenshot) and in the Strategy Tester. The rows use the same engine as AT24 Position Map, which passed 29 hand-worked unit tests and matched an independent Python calculation on real XAUUSD bars (all swings, trends and 27 setups identical) plus a no-look-ahead test. Not verified: live-money use, alerts and push messages on a live connected chart, the licence check with a real purchase. MetaTrader 5 only.

title: AT24 Currency Strength Meter
description:
AT24 Currency Strength Meter shows how strong or weak each of the eight major currencies is, measured from the 28 major pairs on your chart timeframe.

What it does

- Draws one line for each of EUR, USD, GBP, JPY, CHF, AUD, CAD and NZD in a separate window. A line above zero means the currency gained against the others over the measuring period, below zero means it lost.

- Ranking panel: the eight currencies from strongest to weakest, with the value, and a mark when the rank moved up or down compared with a number of bars ago.

- Widest gap: shows the strongest and the weakest currency and how far apart they are.

- Each currency is the average move of all pairs that contain it, so a move in one pair does not decide the result.

- Works on any chart and timeframe. The measuring period is a number of bars of the chart timeframe, and the lines can be smoothed.

- Reads broker prefix and suffix from the chart symbol, or you can enter them. Pairs your broker does not offer are skipped and the panel shows how many of the 28 pairs were used.

- Optional alert and push message when the strongest or weakest currency changes. They are off by default.

Points to know

- The values describe what already happened. They are not a signal and not a forecast, and a strong currency against a weak one does not mean a trade will work.

- The newest bar updates while it forms. Closed bars keep their values.

- Add the major pairs to Market Watch so the history is available. The first calculation can take a moment while the history of 28 symbols loads.

- The panel is hidden in the Strategy Tester by default.

Inputs

Measuring bars, smoothing, history bars, rank comparison bars, broker prefix and suffix, alerts, panel and its position.

Descriptive history on your broker data. Context tool, not a signal or a forecast. Not financial advice. Trading leveraged products is risky.

What was verified: compiles with 0 errors and 0 warnings in the real MetaEditor and runs on a real MT5 chart (see the screenshot) and in the Strategy Tester. The strength lines match an independent recomputation from the raw 28 pairs on MT5 with no difference (worst 0.00000000). Four bugs found by that check were fixed before release. title: AT24 SMC Toolkit
description:
AT24 SMC Toolkit puts market structure, order blocks and fair value gaps on one chart and shows what price really did at these places in your own history.

What it does

- Market structure: marks BOS (break of structure) and CHoCH (change of character) from confirmed swings. A break needs a bar close beyond the level, and a swing is used only after it is confirmed, so marks do not move after they are drawn. The panel shows the current structure (up or down), the last break and the last swing high and low.

- Order blocks: marks the last opposite candle before a strong move, as zones that stay on the chart until price touches them.

- Fair value gaps: marks three-bar gaps as zones that stay on the chart until price trades through them.

- Statistics for every module on your own chart, shown in the panel: how often price kept going after a break, how often it came back to a block or gap and reacted, each one compared with a control level, so you see whether a zone behaves differently from any other level.

- Structure check: the reaction rate of order blocks when the structure agreed with the block, next to the rate when it did not.

- Zone in play: the panel tells you when price touched a zone for the first time on the last closed bar, and whether the structure agrees with that zone.

- Optional alert and push message for a CHoCH, a BOS, or a return to a zone that agrees with the structure. They are off by default.

- Works on any symbol and timeframe. Each module can be switched off, and the number of zones drawn can be set.

Points to know

- It marks zones and measures the past. It is not a trade instruction and does not promise results. A zone can fail, and the statistics can be close to what any other level gives. That is what the control values are for.

- Everything is computed on closed bars, so earlier marks stay in place.

- The indicator needs about 1200 bars of history on the chart.

- The panel is hidden in the Strategy Tester by default.

Inputs

Modules on or off, history bars, swing size, statistic bars, order block and gap detection settings, number of zones drawn, colours, alerts, panel corner and offsets.

title: AT24 Trade Manager
description:
AT24 Trade Manager is a chart panel for manual traders. It calculates the lot size from your risk, places the order with your stop loss and take profit lines, manages open positions and can lock the account when a loss limit is reached.

What it does

- Lot size from risk: percent of balance, percent of equity or a fixed amount. Drag the SL and TP lines on the chart and the panel shows the stop distance, the reward to risk ratio and the lot size before you click.

- BUY and SELL buttons send a market order with the stop loss and take profit from the lines. Orders are refused when the stop is on the wrong side, too close for the broker, or when free margin is not enough.

- Spread check: a warning appears when the spread is a large share of the stop distance.

- Break-even, partial close and trailing stop, each can be switched on or off from the panel. Trailing modes: fixed points, ATR or the last closed candles.

- Buttons: break-even now, close half, close all, flip the lines for a sell setup, change the risk step by step.

- Account lock: set a daily loss limit and a drawdown limit from peak equity. When a limit is reached the panel can close all positions, delete pending orders, block new orders and send an alert and a push message. The daily lock resets on the next server day.

Points to know

- The utility places no trades by itself. It acts only when you press a button, and it manages positions with the rules you set.

- It works on the symbol of the chart where it runs. Managed positions can be all positions of that symbol or only the ones opened from the panel.

- The account lock closes all positions of the account when it triggers, also those of other expert advisors. Set the limits with this in mind.

- Market orders only in this version.

- Demo it first. The Strategy Tester shows the panel but the buttons need a visual test.

Inputs

Risk mode and size, magic number, slippage, spread warning, management scope, break-even, partial close, trailing settings, daily loss and drawdown limits, alerts and panel position.

Trading involves risk. This is a tool, not a signal and not financial advice.

What was verified: compiles with 0 errors and 0 warnings in the real MetaEditor and runs on a real MT5 chart (see the screenshot) and in the Strategy Tester. Lot size from risk, the order with its stop and target lines, the partial close then break-even move and the daily loss lock were tested in the Strategy Tester on a broker demo feed. The same logic was tested live on a demo account in the MT4 edition, which is not part of this download. title: AT24 Prop Firm Guard
description:
AT24 Prop Firm Guard watches the whole account against the rules of a challenge or funded account and closes positions before a limit is broken. It opens no trades.

What it does

- Daily loss: shows how much of your daily limit is used, with a bar and the amount left. The limit can be a percent of the initial balance or of the balance at the start of the day. You choose the server hour when the day starts.

- Maximum loss: the same for the total limit, counted from the initial balance or from the highest equity reached.

- Safety margin: a warning at one share of a limit (default 70 percent) and an action at a higher share (default 92 percent). The action closes all positions, deletes pending orders and locks the account for the rest of the day, or until you reset it for the maximum loss.

- Profit target and minimum trading days: progress is shown on the panel. Optional lock when the target is reached.

- Open risk: adds up the risk of all open positions from their stop losses, flags positions without a stop loss, and closes the newest position when your open risk limit is passed.

- Schedule: close everything on Friday from an hour you set, and close positions that were opened in your quiet hours.

- Works on the whole account: all symbols and the trades of all expert advisors and manual orders. It does not matter on which chart it runs.

- Alert and push message when a warning or action happens.

Points to know

- Rules differ between firms. Enter the numbers of your own firm and read its rules. The guard does not guarantee that an account stays inside its rules or that a challenge is passed.

- Gaps, slippage, spread and a slow connection can take the account past a limit before a close is executed. The safety margin helps, it is not a guarantee.

- When it acts it closes all positions of the account, also those of other expert advisors.

- The initial balance is taken from the balance when the guard is first attached, or from the input if you set it.

- It places no orders and gives no signals.

Inputs

Initial balance, daily loss limit and its basis, day start hour, maximum loss limit and mode, profit target, minimum days, warning and action levels, close on action, lock at target, open risk limit, Friday close hour, quiet hours, alerts and panel position.

Trading involves risk. This is a tool, not a signal and not financial advice.

title: AT24 Basket Closer
description:
AT24 Basket Closer closes a group of open trades with one click, or automatically at a profit target, a loss limit or a trailing basket profit.

What it does

- Panel on the chart with the number of positions, buys and sells, total lots, net profit or loss in money and in percent of balance, winners and losers, and the best and worst position.

- One-click buttons: close all, close winners, close losers, close buys, close sells. Every close button asks for a second click within four seconds, so nothing closes by accident.

- The basket can be all trades, the trades of the chart symbol, or the trades of one magic number. The scope button on the panel changes it at any time. Trades outside the basket are not touched.

- Automatic rules, switched on and off from the panel: close the basket at a profit amount or a percent of balance, at a loss amount or a percent of balance, or with a trailing basket profit that closes when the profit falls a set percent below its peak.

- When everything is closed, pending orders of the basket can be deleted as well.

- Alert and push message when an automatic rule closes the basket. The result of each close is written on the panel and to the Experts log, including trades that could not be closed.

Points to know

- It opens no trades. It only closes trades that already exist.

- Net profit includes swap. Brokers that charge commission per deal may show a slightly different final result.

- Trades are closed one after another at market price. In a fast market the prices can differ from the panel, and a close can be rejected by the broker. A trade that could not be closed is reported on the panel.

- Automatic rules work only while the chart is open and the terminal is connected. They are not a replacement for a stop loss on each trade.

- Algo trading must be allowed for the EA.

Inputs

Starting scope and magic number, delete pending orders, slippage, automatic rules (profit and loss amounts and percents, trailing start and give-back), alerts, panel position.

Utility for managing existing trades. Not financial advice. Trading leveraged products is risky.
